centres.name: ONCAMPUS Amsterdam
centres.partner_university: Wittenborg University of Applied Sciences; University of Amsterdam (MQP)

programs.name: University Pathway Programme (UPP) - Business
programs.progression: Propaedeutic Year 1 (60 ECTS) leading to Wittenborg bachelor's degrees; may qualify for research universities (UvA, Utrecht, VU Amsterdam)

programs.name: Master's Qualifying Programme (MQP)
programs.progression: Guaranteed progression (subject to criteria) to postgraduate degrees at the University of Amsterdam
programs.field: Business, Accountancy and Control, Data Science and Business Analytics, Economics, Econometrics

centres.name: ONCAMPUS Paris
centres.partner_university: KEDGE, Paris School of Business, LISAA, Istituto Marangoni, NABA, Aivancity, AIM Paris, Schiller International University, Swiss Hotel Management School and others

programs.name: International Foundation Programme (IFP)
programs.progression: Undergraduate degrees at KEDGE, Paris School of Business, LISAA, Istituto Marangoni, MJM, NABA, Domus Academy, Aivancity and others
programs.field: Business & Management; Art and Design; Business, IT & Future Technologies

programs.name: International Year One (IY1)
programs.progression: Guaranteed progression to Year 2 at partner institutions (KEDGE, PSB, LISAA, Istituto Marangoni, AIM Paris, Schiller, SHMS, Aivancity, CCCLX, ECE)
programs.field: Business; Fashion Management; Hospitality and Tourism; Computer Science

programs.name: International Pre-Master's Programme (IPMP)
programs.progression: Guaranteed progression to 100+ Master's degrees at partner institutions
programs.field: Business & Management, Finance, Marketing, AI/Data/Technology, Fashion & Luxury, Architecture, Media, Sustainability, Hospitality

centres.name: ONCAMPUS Ireland
centres.partner_university: Maynooth University, SETU, DCU, University of Galway, Munster Technological University and others; Medical University Pleven (medical route)

programs.name: International Foundation Programme (IFP)
programs.english_req: IELTS 5.0 (min 5.0 writing, no other band below 4.5)
programs.progression: QQI Level 5 certificate (about 60 ECTS); guaranteed place on undergraduate programme at partner institutions
programs.field: Business & Social Sciences; Engineering & Science; Engineering & Science (medical routes)

programs.name: Pre-Master's Programme (PMP)
programs.progression: Guaranteed place on postgraduate programme at partner institutions (60 ECTS, NFQ Level 8, awarded by TU Dublin)

gaps: No US centre: ONCAMPUS Boston is not listed on oncampus.global (centres list shows only UK, Amsterdam, Ireland, Paris); a 2012 press item mentioned Boston but it appears discontinued.
English requirements not stated on Amsterdam and Paris programme pages (entry requirements pages not fetched).
Paris fees vary by 2/2.5/3 semesters; the 2-semester 2026-27 fee is recorded (IFP 21,600; IY1 20,580; IPMP 22,140; 3-semester IFP 28,460, IY1 27,440, IPMP 29,000). Excludes EUR 450 registration fee.

Ireland IFP fee 16,330 is the 2026-27 Business & Social Sciences/Engineering & Science figure; medical routes EUR 20,450; 2027-28 higher. Extra fees apply (EUR 300 admin; PMP also 1,200 registration etc.). Ireland PMP campus is Maynooth.

Amsterdam fees: UPP 22,980 for Sep-27 progression (24,180 for Sep-28); MQP 26,970 for 2026-27 (28,380 for 2027-28); plus EUR 450 registration. Amsterdam UPP intake months taken from dated start dates (Oct/Jan).
Ireland pre-Master centre-level page also mentions a Pleven medical pathway (not fetched, not recorded as separate programme). Ireland IY1 not offered per centre page.
